title: Buffer/overlay: schools within a mile (live OpenStreetMap)
query: How many schools does OpenStreetMap have within 1 mile of 41.9231 N, 87.7093 W?

expected_why.count_within_mile: Overpass https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter at run time, nwr amenity=school

answer:
**Answer: 20 schools** are within 1 mile of the point at 41.9231 N, 87.7093 W (Chicago's Logan Square / Avondale area).

I searched OpenStreetMap for `amenity=school` features in the surrounding area, which returned 94 schools in the bounding box. I then measured each school's distance to the reference point and counted those within 1 mile (1,609.344 m).

The 20 schools within 1 mile include:

1. Darwin Elementary School (0.35 km)
2. Saint Sylvester School (0.59 km)
3. St. Sylvester's School & Hall (0.69 km)
4. Funston Elementary School (0.87 km)
5. Jehovah School (0.99 km)
6. (unnamed school) (1.01 km)
7. Our Lady of Grace School (1.01 km)
8. Logan Square Elementary School (1.07 km)
9. Mozart Elementary School (1.09 km)
10. Stowe Elementary School (1.20 km)
11. Yates Elementary School (1.22 km)
12. Marine Leadership Academy (1.31 km)
13. Chase Elementary School (1.32 km)
14. Avondale-Logandale Elementary School (1.32 km)
15. Goethe Elementary School (1.32 km)
16. St. Hyacinth Catholic School (1.41 km)
17. Brentano Elementary Math and Science Academy (1.43 km)
18. McAuliffe Elementary School (1.51 km)
19. Moos Elementary School (1.53 km)
20. ASPIRA Business & Finance High School (1.60 km)

**Method note:** Distances were computed metrically (haversine on school centroids, cross-checked with a QGIS metric buffer of 1 mile in EPSG:26916). A buffer `intersects` test returned 21 because St. John Berchmans School's polygon edge just touches the 1-mile circle, but its actual location (centroid) is at 1.014 miles (1,632 m) — outside 1 mile — so it is not counted. The count of 20 reflects schools whose location is genuinely within 1 mile.

Both layers have been placed on your interactive map: the **OSM Schools (Chicago)** point layer (94 schools) and the **1-mile buffer** around the reference point.
